title: Second Giza scan paper under peer review

tellings.quote: So, in this moment we are working on a scientific paper.

plain: A second scientific paper on radar scans beneath the Pyramid of Khafre, the second-largest pyramid at Giza, is being written and is under review, according to Filippo Biondi, the Italian scientist who took part in the scans. He tells Michels, "in this moment we are working on a scientific paper" in 2025. If it passes review, the team's claims about what lies under the pyramid would enter the scientific record.
